text: Is my easy pace too fast?

No, your easy pace looks well judged. Your easy runs sit at 5:42-5:52/km, in the middle of the 5:11-6:13/km easy band. The 4-week easy average is 5:47/km (347 s) at 141 bpm, which is about 75% of your 188 max HR. Individual runs were 137-140 bpm: 5:42/km at 138 on Nov 5, 5:44/km at 140 on Nov 12 and 5:46/km at 139 on Nov 21. Km splits are nearly identical within each run, so you aren't surging or drifting.

The long runs sit a little higher, as expected. 143 bpm on Nov 15 at 5:50/km, then 146 bpm on Nov 22 at 5:52/km. Some of that is the 186 m of climbing on the 18.6 km run, so I'd keep an eye on it but it isn't a concern yet. Nov 7 had no HR data, so I can't confirm effort for that one.

If anything the risk is on the quality days rather than the easy ones. The Nov 10 tempo went out at 5:00/km against 4:37/km and you stopped at 6 km, while Nov 3 and Nov 17 were held at 4:36-4:37/km. Keep the tempo reps to target pace.

Separately, nothing is logged since the Nov 22 long run, so week 4 (38.4 km planned) is untouched so far, with Thursday's reps next. If something is going on, tell me and we can look at the plan.

text: Swap Thursday and Saturday next week please, I'm travelling Thursday.

A straight swap won't work. Putting the Thursday 4 × 0.8 km intervals on Saturday Dec 5 would put a hard session the day before the Sunday Dec 6 long run, and the plan doesn't allow hard runs on consecutive days. Moving them to Wednesday has the same problem, because Tuesday Dec 1 is the 2 × 3 km tempo.

With Thursday gone, you have four run days left (Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun) and only two of them can be hard. I'd keep the Tuesday tempo and the long run, which are the key sessions in a threshold-focused week. Wednesday would become an easy 8 km run in place of the ride, with Strength B moved to Wednesday and Saturday staying an easy 8 km. The cost is that you skip the intervals that week. Week 6 has 5 × 1 km, so you aren't losing much.

If you'd rather keep the intervals and drop the tempo, tell me. I'm sending this as a proposal for you to accept; I haven't changed anything yet.

Separately, nothing is logged since the Nov 22 long run, so this week's Thursday reps are still open.
